meta.title: feat: optimize slot calculation performance for team event types
meta.body_summary: Optimize team event slot calculation by replacing O(n^2) linear search with binary search and caching, claiming 20% speedup in stress tests.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added binary search and stress tests claiming 20% speedup; no substantive human review; PR closed automatically after 7 days inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 7579 changed lines, this is a large edit by absolute volume, but 7090 lines are from yarn.lock churn due to revert cycles; the actual performance change in slots.ts is 26 lines. The PR was closed without merge due to inactivity, consistent with many agent PRs that lack maintainer review engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: The only formal review was an emoji (🚀) which was later dismissed; no performance or correctness feedback was provided. Human involvement was limited to labeling and requesting reviews without further action.
review_details.performance_claim: Binary search optimization reduces slot calculation time from 5-7.5s for 4 weeks to ~2s target, with stress tests showing 20% improvement (209.5ms → 167.5ms).
review_details.antipattern_addressed: O(n^2)_linear_search (prior behavior; not in taxonomy enum)
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed automatically by Devin bot due to inactivity for more than 7 days; no human merge or review completion.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR demonstrates algorithmic optimization capability (binary search, caching), but its inability to get merged highlights a process boundary: without timely human review, agent PRs are subject to automatic closure, lacking maintainer engagement or performance-validation steps.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code-review by maintainer; review was requested but never performed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes stress tests with timing numbers, but no separate benchmark profile or production validation; maintainer never verified.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by Devin bot after 7 days inactivity; no regression issues were identified or fixed.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/lib/slots.ts, replaced linear slot boundary search with binary search and added a sorted boundaries cache; stress tests added in slots.test.ts; util.ts changes reverted after CI failures; yarn.lock churn from reverts.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: util.ts initially had additional optimizations (early termination, performance logging) but they were reverted due to CI issues; yarn.lock changes are 7,090 lines of churn from adding and removing dependencies.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (05c58c5): binary search optimization in slots.ts + early termination/cache in util.ts.
CI failures led to reverting util.ts changes (7a1338c) and adjusting yarn.lock (af855bbe, 9717582).
Added comprehensive stress tests (769dedb) with performance measurements (15ms vs 1900ms).
Added intensive 2000-range stress test (b3639b) showing 209.5ms→167.5ms (20% improvement).
Enhanced tests with exact slot assertions (1bf2067), then fixed boundary violations (9c249cd).

review_signals.summary: Review consisted of a rocket emoji (🚀) and was later dismissed.
Closed PR due to 7+ days inactivity.
No security or compliance issues detected.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with binary search optimization and initial util.ts changes.
CI failures prompted revert of util.ts changes and yarn.lock adjustments.
Stress tests with numeric performance claims were added.
Maintainer assigned, labeled ready-for-e2e, and requested reviews; one emoji review submitted then dismissed.
After 7 days with no further human review, Devin bot auto‑closed the PR.
